objective: Narrow primary-source search for an earlier two-species fully endotactic stochastic mass-action non-explosion theorem through maximum source order 3, a lower bound 4, or a source-order-3/4/5 fully endotactic explosive counterexample.
status: No such primary source was located in this bounded search. This is not novelty or priority clearance.

definitions.source_order: max over reactions y->y' of ||y||_1, the sum of reactant/source coefficients.
definitions.full_endotactic: u-endotactic for every u in R^d; not a condition at a single vector such as (1,1).

locators.source_reported: Network order is the maximum reactant/source-complex molecularity.
Full endotactic means u-endotactic for every u in R^d.

locators.location: Theorem 4.6 and proof, p. 9 / HTML lines 286-314
locators.source_reported: Every second-order endotactic mass-action system is regular, in every dimension. The proof invokes the special total-count drift fact for second-order reactions. No order-three theorem is stated.
The known explosive strongly endotactic example is order 10; the minimum order for explosive endotactic stochastic mass-action systems is stated to remain open.
Two-species endotactic permanence cited here is for deterministic mass-action systems, not stochastic non-explosion.

A source-order-three termolecular network is strongly (1,1)-endotactic and explosive on the stated classes. Its full-endotactic status is not claimed; the phase-2 source audit reconstructs a violating u=e1 direction.
